Here's what nobody tells you.

A quick note from Brendan

Most homeowners have never had concrete done before.

It's a big spend. Every quote looks different.
And it's hard to know who to trust.

Here's the thing. All concrete cracks.

What matters is how it cracks.

Done right, control joints are cut in the right places, so it cracks along the joint lines.
Neat, minimal and barely noticeable.

But a lot of concreters only care how it looks on day one.
They rush the base prep, skimp on reinforcement, get paid and leave.

Then it cracks wherever it wants.
Wide cracks. Slabs shifting on either side. Trip hazards and expensive fixes down the line.

And those problems only show up once they've gone.

For our hard-working clients, getting it done right once versus ripping it up and starting again...

could mean missing out on a family holiday.
Or penny pinching to save up all over again.

That's why we don't cut corners.

Every Limitless driveway gets a properly compacted base, the right reinforcement and control joints cut where they should be.
Poured with stronger 32 MPa concrete as standard.
And priced on a fixed written quote, so nothing extra turns up on the final invoice.

We've built our reputation on how long every job lasts.

At your consult, I'll show you exactly what you're getting and why.

20+ years experience. 2,000+ jobs.
I'd love to help with yours.

B
BrendanLimitless Paving

Built stronger as standard

Every job gets 32 MPa concrete

Concrete strength is measured in MPa, and the higher the number, the more it handles. Most domestic driveways are poured at 25 MPa, the industry minimum. We don't. A stronger, denser mix stands up to heavier loads, resists cracking and holds its finish for longer.

Industry minimum25MPa
Every Limitless job32MPa

Around 28% stronger, poured on every job as standard at no extra cost. A small detail that makes a real difference to how long your concrete lasts.

Good to know

Common questions

Is the design consult really free?
Yes. We come to you, measure up, talk through finishes and give you a fixed written quote. It takes around 30 minutes and there's no obligation to go ahead.
Will my concrete crack?
All concrete can crack, it's the nature of the material. What matters is how. We lay a properly compacted, reinforced base and cut control joints in the right places, so any cracking happens neatly along the joints and stays minimal. Rushed jobs skip this, which is what leads to wide random cracks and slabs shifting either side, creating trip hazards and costly repairs.
How much will my driveway cost?
It depends on size, finish and your site. As a guide, a single exposed aggregate driveway of around 60 m² starts from $9,750, and plain concrete starts from $110 per m². Your exact price is locked in on a fixed written quote at your consult.
Can you remove my old driveway?
Yes. We break out and cart away your old concrete before the new pour, from $20 per m². It's all included in your written quote so there are no surprises.
What does 32 MPa mean for me?
MPa measures concrete strength. Most driveways are poured at 25 MPa, the industry minimum. We pour 32 MPa on every job as standard, around 28% stronger, so it handles heavier loads, resists cracking and keeps its finish for longer.
Who actually does the work?
Our own crew, led by Brendan. The same team handles prep, pour, finish and clean up, and keeps you informed the whole way through.
What areas do you cover?
We're based in Langwarrin and work across the Mornington Peninsula and South East Melbourne.
